mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.external_key AS "externalKey", s.title, s.summary, s.star_level AS "starLevel", COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS "caseCount", COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS "attemptCount" FROM scenario s LEFT JOIN scenario_case c ON c.scenario_id = s.id LEFT JOIN scenario_attempt a ON a.scenario_id = s.id AND a.profile_id = #{profileId} WHERE s.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT id, external_key AS "externalKey", title, summary, star_level AS "starLevel", origin_type AS "originType", source_version AS "sourceVersion" FROM scenario WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT id, external_key AS "externalKey", title, summary, star_level AS "starLevel", origin_type AS "originType", source_version AS "sourceVersion" FROM scenario WHERE external_key = #{externalKey}

SELECT id, scenario_id AS "scenarioId", code, title, root_cause AS "rootCause", prompt, expected_analysis::text AS "expectedAnalysisJson", sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM scenario_case WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, NULL::BIGINT AS "scenarioId", code, name, principle, pros, cons, boundary_text AS "boundary", sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM scenario_solution ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT cs.case_id AS "caseId", cs.solution_id AS "solutionId", cs.recommendation, cs.reason, cs.sort_order AS "sortOrder" FROM scenario_case_solution cs JOIN scenario_case c ON c.id = cs.case_id WHERE c.scenario_id = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY cs.case_id, cs.sort_order, cs.solution_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario WHERE id = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_case WHERE id = #{caseId} AND scenario_id = #{scenarioId}

SELECT id, profile_id AS "profileId", scenario_id AS "scenarioId", case_id AS "caseId", client_attempt_id AS "clientAttemptId", self_rating AS "selfRating", result_type AS "resultType", duration_seconds AS "durationSeconds", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM scenario_attempt WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND client_attempt_id = #{clientAttemptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE scenario SET title = #{item.title}, summary = #{item.summary}, star_level = #{item.starLevel}, seed_pack = #{pack}, source_version = #{version}, version = scenario.version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE external_key = #{item.externalKey} AND origin_type IN ('BUILTIN', 'IMPORTED') AND (origin_type = 'BUILTIN' OR seed_pack = #{pack})
mapper.select: INSERT INTO scenario_case ( scenario_id, code, title, root_cause, prompt, expected_analysis, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{scenarioId}, #{item.code}, #{item.title}, #{item.rootCause}, #{item.title}, CAST(#{expectedAnalysisJson} AS JSONB), #{sortOrder} ) ON CONFLICT (scenario_id, code) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, root_cause = EXCLUDED.root_cause, prompt = EXCLUDED.prompt, expected_analysis = EXCLUDED.expected_analysis, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

INSERT INTO scenario_solution (code, name, principle, sort_order) VALUES (#{item.code}, #{item.name}, #{item.principle}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, principle = EXCLUDED.principle, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scenario_case_solution WHERE case_id IN (SELECT id FROM scenario_case WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId})
